subject.title: [Bug] Telegram exec approval bubble not dismissed after clicking approve

question: Should maintainers close, adopt, or replace the open conflicting fork PR before allowing a new fix PR for this Telegram approval cleanup?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but an open linked fork PR still claims the fix while targeting an obsolete handler path and remaining conflicting.

options.title: Replace with a fresh narrow fix
options.body: Close or ignore the conflicting fork PR as non-landing and allow a new PR against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with live Telegram proof.

options.title: Adopt the fork work
options.body: Ask a maintainer or contributor to rebuild the fork PR onto the current native approval runtime and drop the obsolete docs/handler churn.

options.title: Wait on the fork PR
options.body: Keep this issue parked behind the conflicting fork PR, accepting that the current main bug remains unfixed.

recommendation.title: Replace with a fresh narrow fix
recommendation.body: Close or ignore the conflicting fork PR as non-landing and allow a new PR against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The native approval lifecycle and Telegram runtime seam were introduced in this area by gumadeiras, making them the best routing candidate for the fix shape decision.
